The partnership combines a shared commitment to client-first advice and investment excellence while enhancing the overall client experience.

title: Cosette Pharmaceuticals® Establishes Oncology Franchise Through Acquisition of MARGENZA® (margetuximab-cmkb) from TerSera® Therapeutics
notes: The acquisition establishes oncology as a core franchise for the company and provides a platform to build a broader presence in the therapeutic area.

title: LiveChain Completes Acquisition of MIT-Originated Humanyze Assets, Positioning it for the Next Frontier of Enterprise AI
notes: LiveChain aims to leverage the acquired workforce intelligence software and intellectual property to explore AI-powered solutions for optimizing collaboration between humans and AI agents. This acquisition serves as a foundational step for the company to establish a position in the emerging enterprise intelligence market.

title: Shift4 Completes Acquisition of Paramount Commerce
notes: The acquisition broadens Shift4's payment ecosystem by incorporating real-time account-to-account payment capabilities and specialized gaming expertise. This allows the company to enhance its global platform and provide enterprise merchants with faster, frictionless payment solutions.

title: BlackSky Acquires EpochGeo to Expand Real-Time Intelligence Capabilities with AI-Enabled RF, Signals and Multi-Source Analytics
notes: The acquisition aims to expand BlackSky's real-time intelligence capabilities by integrating EpochGeo's AI-enabled multi-source analytics and RF signals expertise. This combination allows BlackSky to provide more comprehensive intelligence solutions and better support for mission-critical defense applications.

title: Wellable Acquires Givhero's Employee Well-Being Business
notes: This acquisition enables Wellable to expand its corporate wellness customer business. It allows Givhero to focus its technology and expertise on nonprofit fundraising, social impact, and volunteering.

title: Cerberus to Acquire the U.S. Space Systems Business of Airbus
notes: Cerberus intends to invest in the company's engineering organization, product portfolio, and U.S. supply chain to build a leading independent, U.S.-owned satellite platform that can scale to meet growing national security and commercial mission requirements. The acquisition aims to expand the business's capabilities and solidify its role as a trusted merchant supplier by establishing dedicated U.S. ownership.

title: Stratix Acquires DMI's Managed Mobility Services Business
notes: The acquisition adds expanded logistics, help desk capabilities, and a new Chicago depot to Stratix's portfolio, enhancing its reach and depth across the enterprise device lifecycle. The transaction combines the teams and enterprise customer relationships of both companies to strengthen their support for comprehensive managed mobility programs.

title: Revau Advanced Underwriting Announces Acquisition of H.W. Kaufman Group’s Canadian MGA and Claims Business, Burns & Wilcox Canada, Strengthening Its Presence in Canada
notes: This acquisition strengthens Revau's position as the largest independent MGA in Canada and expands its national platform and specialty underwriting capabilities. It also adds in-house claims administration capabilities and broadens the company's distribution network.

title: Intune Physical Therapy Acquires Kinect Physiotherapy, Further Expanding Its Presence in the Raleigh Market
notes: The acquisition strengthens Intune's presence in the Raleigh market and supports its continued expansion throughout North Carolina and the Southeast. This partnership allows Kinect Physiotherapy to gain support and resources for long-term success while preserving its local culture and leadership.

title: Applied Systems Acquires Tailwind
notes: The acquisition aims to accelerate integrated AI automation across insurance policy workflows, reducing time and costs. By integrating Tailwind’s document and data retrieval technology, Applied Systems intends to improve connectivity and efficiency for agencies, brokers, and carriers.

title: VIRTUS Diversified REIT Expands Seniors Housing Footprint with Acquisition of The Regency Retirement Residence in Lakefield, Ontario
notes: The acquisition expands the company's seniors housing footprint and strengthens portfolio diversification. The transaction aims to deploy capital efficiently while generating durable cash flow through accretive, yield-focused assets.

title: Georgia Ports Authority Backs Union Pacific-Norfolk Southern Merger, Joining More Than 2,000 Supporters
notes: The merger aims to create the nation's first seamless transcontinental railroad. This combination is intended to strengthen freight connectivity, expand access to inland markets, and provide single-line service to more destinations.

title: FCP ACQUIRES 2048 BOLTON DRIVE NW IN UPPER WESTSIDE ATLANTA
notes: The company acquired the asset to add a quality, infill multifamily community with access to retail and employment centers to its portfolio.

title: Duravant to Acquire FlexXray, Technology Leader in Foreign Material Inspection and Recovery Services
notes: The acquisition adds advanced inspection technology and a recurring aftermarket business model to Duravant's portfolio. It also creates synergistic commercial opportunities by linking the two companies' complementary technologies and customer relationships.

title: RHONDOS Completes Acquisition of PowerConnect for SAP® Solutions
notes: The acquisition brings full ownership of PowerConnect IP to RHONDOS to advance SAP observability, cybersecurity, and AI-ready data. This integration aims to streamline product development, support, and long-term investment for customers running systems on SAP.

title: Digi International Completes Acquisition of Disruptive Technologies, Expanding SmartSense Physical-World Intelligence Capabilities
notes: This acquisition expands the SmartSense physical-world intelligence platform by integrating advanced wireless sensing technology with enterprise software. The deal aims to enhance operational insights for industries like food and healthcare while opening new markets in building automation.

title: Five9 Completes Acquisition of Level AI
notes: The acquisition aims to advance Five9's AI capabilities and strengthen its position in the AI-powered customer experience market. It seeks to integrate Level AI's applications into the Five9 Genius CX Platform to enable AI and human agents to work together as a coordinated system.

title: Local Bounti Becomes Largest Leafy Greens CEA Grower in the U.S. with Completed Acquisition of Revol Greens' Certified-Organic Facilities
notes: The acquisition expands Local Bounti’s growing footprint by approximately 70% and adds certified-organic greens to its product offering. This transaction allows the company to meet customer demand more quickly and cost-effectively than building new facilities.
funding: Secured notes, seller financing and assumed debt

title: Remix Therapeutics Completes Closing of Merger with Passage Bio and Previously Announced $100 Million Private Placement
notes: Rationale not stated.

title: Thor Equities Completes Acquisition of Prime San Francisco Asset for $50.5 Million
notes: The acquirer views this high-quality asset as an irreplaceable location with significant potential and intends to build a significant presence in the Union Square market.

title: Pivotal Manufacturing Partners Acquires 753,428-Square-Foot Advanced Manufacturing Facility in the Dallas–Fort Worth Metroplex
notes: The acquisition of the 753,428-square-foot advanced manufacturing facility serves to expand Pivotal Manufacturing Partners' footprint within the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex. Rationale not stated.

title: OpenTable Announces Proposed Acquisition of Australian Restaurant Technology Company me&u
notes: The acquisition aims to combine OpenTable’s reservation capabilities with me&u’s AI-native product suite to provide a comprehensive, connected set of tools for restaurant operators. This move allows OpenTable to offer a broader range of solutions and expand the scale of me&u's tools for hospitality venues.

title: ValOre Metals Announces Definitive Agreement to Acquire Bemisa Água Azul Mineração S.A., Owner of the Água Azul Gold Project in Pará State, Brazil
notes: ValOre Metals Corp. aims to become a precious metals producer of scale by acquiring an operating gold project with expansion potential. The deal adds a cash-generating open-pit gold operation in the Carajás Mineral Province to ValOre's portfolio.

title: EQUASENS enters into exclusive negotiations to acquire a majority stake in Synapse Medicine, the developer of MedGPT and a pharmaceutical database
notes: The acquisition aims to complement the acquirer's healthcare solutions by integrating a certified drug database and advanced medical AI technology. This move is expected to enhance patient safety and improve the functionality of the acquirer's healthcare software applications.

title: UK Competition and Markets Authority in principle accepts remedies in AkzoNobel-Axalta merger
notes: The combination brings together two leading coatings companies with complementary portfolios, technologies, and brands to create a global coatings company.

title: Agreement to Acquire Ready-Mix Concrete Operations by INTERBETON
notes: The acquisition strengthens the company's ready-mix concrete network and vertical integration in the Attica market. It aims to broaden geographic coverage and support major infrastructure and development projects.

title: Standard BioTools Announces 1-for-35 Reverse Stock Split and Special Dividend of Contingent Value Rights in Connection with Proposed Merger with Treeline Biosciences
notes: Rationale not stated.

title: Schrödinger Acquires ENPICOM to Establish End-to-End Computational Platform for Biologics Discovery
notes: The acquisition aims to establish an end-to-end computational platform for biologics discovery. This deal combines the companies' technologies to enhance the speed and success rate of drug discovery.

title: PHINIA to Acquire the Business of the FMP Group with Operations in Australia, Thailand and Malaysia, a Leading Asia-Pacific Aftermarket Company
notes: The acquisition expands PHINIA's presence in the Asia-Pacific aftermarket and adds a broader propulsion-agnostic product portfolio. It also provides a regional platform with established customer relationships and vertically integrated capabilities.

title: Gulf Resources Announces Agreement to Acquire Bromine and Crude Salt Assets
notes: The company believes this acquisition could significantly expand its bromine and crude salt production. The facilities and crude salt fields are located in the same city as existing operations, allowing for operational synergies.
target: Bromine and crude salt assets from the collective economic organization of Caiyangzi Village
funding: Cash 8.30 million CNY and 355,000 restricted shares

title: Expedia Group Announces Agreement to Acquire Kiwi.com to Augment Flights Capabilities
notes: The acquisition aims to augment Expedia Group's air platform with Kiwi.com's supply, technology, and customer service capabilities. This move is intended to extend Expedia Group's U.S. air position into Europe and unlock growth opportunities for both consumer brands and B2B partners.

title: Cheche Group Signs Definitive Agreement to Acquire 20% Interest in Residential Solar-Plus-Storage Company Long Way Fortune, With Option to Increase Stake to 51%
notes: The investment supports Cheche's green mobility and energy strategy while creating a second growth engine through home energy storage. By connecting the car and home, Cheche aims to leverage its NEV owner relationships and AI data capabilities.

title: 26Health Acquires Florida Infectious Disease Specialists, Expanding HIV and Infectious Disease Care in Central Florida
notes: The acquisition aims to expand access to specialized HIV and infectious disease care for patients across the Central Florida region. It also strengthens 26Health's specialty care services by integrating the practice's expert providers and resources into its network.

title: American-Led Consortium Announces Agreement to Acquire LUKOIL International’s Global Energy Portfolio
notes: The transaction seeks to secure critical global energy assets under American and allied ownership to strengthen energy security and stabilize operations in various markets. The deal is structured to sever these assets from Russian ownership while avoiding direct cash payments to Russia.

title: Virbac to acquire Axiota Animal Health, Inc. creating a leading global platform for innovative cattle health solutions
notes: This acquisition creates a leading global platform for cattle health solutions and significantly accelerates Virbac's Farm Animal strategy. It expands Virbac's commercial footprint in North America and complements its existing portfolio with specialized preventive care products.

title: Luminate Bank Acquires Select Assets of Real Genius, Expanding Consumer-Direct Mortgage Capabilities
notes: The acquisition adds a digital-first, consumer-direct mortgage platform to Luminate Bank’s existing mortgage business. This creates a complementary channel that allows the bank to serve both self-directed digital borrowers and those who prefer traditional, relationship-driven lending.

title: UPDATE -- Gulf Resources Announces Agreement to Acquire Bromine and Crude Salt Assets
notes: The company believes this acquisition could significantly expand bromine and crude salt production at the site. The assets include crude salt fields that can help increase bromine production through co-production.

title: Virbac to acquire Axiota Animal Health, Inc. - creating a leading global platform for innovative cattle health solutions
notes: The acquisition provides Virbac with a strong foothold in the U.S. ruminant market and integrates innovative products like Multimin® and Lactipro®. This transaction reinforces Virbac's 'Supercharge' platform and adds specialized manufacturing and R&D capabilities to the company.

title: LS Power Completes Acquisition of 4.4 GW Natural Gas Generation Assets from Constellation
notes: The acquisition allows LS Power to further scale its generation footprint in the PJM market to meet growing electricity demand. The assets provide added operational flexibility and reliability due to their dual-fuel capability.

title: REV Acquires Drill-Ready Forty Mile Helium Property with Historical 7 MMcf/d Gas Flow Test at 1.1% Helium
notes: This acquisition creates a “triple play” discovery and development strategy, allowing the company to scale its helium exploration in the American market. The project provides prospective reservoir horizons that the company intends to drill to advance its commercial goals.
